Power telemetry implementation references

This app's IOKit and USB-PD telemetry reader was independently implemented
after consulting the public source and field interpretations in:

- WhatPort: https://github.com/darrylmorley/whatport (MIT License)
- macpow: https://github.com/k06a/macpow (MIT License)

No source files from either project are included or linked into this app.
They are not runtime dependencies. The links are retained as attribution for
the public technical validation of AppleSmartBattery PowerTelemetryData and
PowerOutDetails behavior.
